Nyang Merge Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 23, 2026

You play without creating an account or signing in, and your records are stored only on your device. TeamCP runs no game servers, and the game has no in-app purchases and no Google Play Games integration. The ad services (Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads) process device information and advertising identifiers needed to deliver ads; on first launch we ask whether you consent to personalized ads and do not start the ad SDK until you choose.

Applies to version 1.0.0. We update this page and its date when features or ad setup change.

1. Scope and operator

TeamCP develops and operates the Android game “Nyang Merge” (냥이 합치기, com.teamcp.nyangmerge). This policy explains what information the game handles and the choices you have. Contact: sjw0480@gmail.com.

The game has no account sign-up of its own, no sign-in, no game servers, no chat and no in-app purchases, and it does not use Google Play Games. We do not request or collect your name, email, phone number, location (GPS), contacts, microphone, camera or storage. The only permissions the app itself uses are internet and network state (loading ads) and the advertising ID (AD_ID); the Android ad services attribution and topics APIs may be used by the ad SDK, and the WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions are included by the ad SDK libraries. If you contact support by email, we use your address and message only to reply.

2. Information stored on your device

This information is kept in the app's private Android storage to keep your best score and settings, and is never sent to TeamCP servers. There is no cloud save. The app contains no analytics (such as Firebase Analytics) or crash-reporting tools.

  • Game records: your best score
  • Settings: sound and vibration, personalized-ads choice

3. Android Auto Backup

This app does not turn off Android Auto Backup, so backup and device-to-device transfer are allowed. If Google backup is turned on in your device settings, the game records and settings above may be included in your Google Account backup under Google's policies and restored when you reinstall the app or move to a new device.

This backup is a Google feature controlled by your device settings; TeamCP cannot access it. You can turn it off or delete it in Settings > Google > Backup.

4. Ads and the information ad services process

The game is free and supported by ads, served through Unity LevelPlay (mediation) and Unity Ads. It does not include AdMob, Google ad SDKs, Firebase or payment SDKs.

Ads are: a banner shown at the bottom of the game screen at all times once you have made your consent choice (hidden while a full-screen ad is showing); interstitials shown between rounds with frequency and interval limits; and a rewarded ad (“one more chance” at game over) that plays only when you choose it. You never have to watch a rewarded ad to keep playing.

To load and show ads, the ad services may process:

  • Advertising ID, app set ID and other ad/SDK identifiers
  • Device information such as model, OS, language, screen, network type and carrier
  • IP address and the approximate region derived from it
  • Ad interactions such as impressions and clicks, plus ad-related error and diagnostic data
  • Information about certain installed apps (for example, whether app stores such as Google Play are installed)

These are used to deliver and measure ads, prevent ad fraud, and — with your consent — personalize ads. The app is marked as “not directed to children” with the ad services. TeamCP does not receive individual user data from the ad services; we only see aggregated revenue and impression statistics in their dashboards.

5. Your ad choices

Your choice is stored only on your device and passed to the ad service (Unity LevelPlay) as a consent signal. If you decline, the ad SDK receives a refusal of consent (GDPR consent set to false) together with a “do not sell or share” signal under certain U.S. state laws.

  • Every player is shown an allow/decline choice — “Do you consent to personalized ads?” — on first launch; the ad SDK does not start and no ads are shown until you choose. If you decline, you see the same number of ads but they are not personalized.
  • You can make the choice again anytime under Settings > “광고 동의 다시 보기” (review ad consent).
  • In Android Settings > Privacy > Ads you can reset or delete your advertising ID. Once deleted, a zeroed value is sent instead and cannot be used for personalized ads.
  • Use the privacy icon inside an ad or the Unity policy below to access, delete or opt out of ad data.
  • With the internet turned off no ad requests are made, and the game can still be played offline.

6. Third-party services and international processing

Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads (Unity Technologies) and Google's Android backup and ad services are governed by their own policies. Ad information and backup data may be processed outside your country; see each provider's policy for recipients, locations and safeguards.

TeamCP does not sell your information. However, some laws may treat data processing in the advertising ecosystem as a “sale” or “sharing”, so please also review the opt-out and rights information from the providers below.

7. Deleting data and retention

Game data on your device remains until you delete it. Retention of backup and ad information follows each provider's policy. We keep support emails no longer than needed after replying.

  • On the device: uninstall the app, or use Android Settings > Apps > 냥이 합치기 (Nyang Merge) > Storage > Clear data to erase all game data including settings. TeamCP keeps no information on its servers.
  • Android backup: turn off or delete backups under Settings > Google > Backup.
  • Ad information: delete or reset your advertising ID and use the request process in Unity's policy. Uninstalling the app does not erase information ad providers have already processed.
  • Need help? Email sjw0480@gmail.com with the app name and your request. Never send passwords or ID documents. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will point you to the right provider's process.

8. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale/sharing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Because TeamCP keeps no game data on its own servers, most requests are handled with device settings and the ad providers' processes, and we will tell you which route to use.

9. Children and parents

Nyang Merge is a puzzle game about dropping cats and merging cats of the same tier. It is an all-ages game, but because it contains ads it is not directed to children under 13. The app is marked “not directed to children” with the ad services and has no age check or parental-consent feature.

If you believe a child under 13 has had information processed, contact us and we will explain how to delete it.

10. Security and changes

Game data is kept in the app’s private Android storage, which other apps cannot read. Ad traffic and backups use each provider’s encrypted connections.

When features, SDKs or processing change, we update this policy and its date and announce important changes on this page. If the Korean and English versions of this policy seem to differ, please contact us.
